item.title: Ohio Supreme Court hears Concord Township man’s challenge to damages cap
item.description: More than four years after a post-surgery infection led to the loss of vision in his left eye, 94-year-old Concord Township resident John Paganini is challenging a state limit on noneconomic damages for medical malpractice cases. Trial and appeals courts in Cuyahoga County both sided with Paganini. His case has now gone before the Ohio […]

item.title: High school wrestling: Mayfield takes team title in final year of the WRC with head coach Dwight Fritz
item.description: For one final time, wrestlers laced up their shoes for the WRC tournament at Chardon on Feb. 14. And it was one final round for Mayfield coach Dwight Fritz as well.

item.title: Lake Catholic wrestling: Cougars upset in semifinal round of Division III state duals
item.description: The Lake Catholic wrestling team will have to wait at least another year to break its drought of state dual-meet championships.

item.title: John Carroll men’s, women’s basketball lose doubleheader showdowns at Denison
item.description: It was a tough afternoon of basketball for the John Carroll men's and women's teams Feb. 14 against Denison in Granville.
